Thanks Jared — happy to confirm. A few items from our side:  

- Early entry: We can open the Innovation lobby at 07:30 for gear drop; Marcus (cc'd) will escort the photographer to the demo room for setup.
- Room & timing: Innovation Suite B reserved 09:00–13:00; demo slot at 09:30. If you want a shorter run-through before the demo we can do an AV check at 08:15.
- NDA: Please sign the visitor NDA I attached (Redwood_Visitor_NDA_v3.pdf). DocuSign is preferred for records; but if your legal needs paper copies we can have one at reception.
- Photography permissions: We ask external photographers to sign a simple waiver (attached: photo-waiver-template.docx) and to avoid capture of the secure lab and whiteboards. Lobby photos OK.
- AV: We will provide HDMI and an ATEM Mini feed with a table mic. If you need an RTMP stream from your encoder, we can coordinate IP + port on the morning of.
- Badges: Please send full legal names and government ID types for the contractor (for badge printing).

Action items:  
- Jared: sign the NDA via the DocuSign link and send the contractor name + ID type (e.g., driver’s license).
- Marcus: I’ll let Marcus coordinate the badge pickup and on-site escort.

—
